column5: statements  (`;`-separated; `f=expr` sets the state field, `+f:Type=expr` adds the field to the state record first; `e.` is the event)

draftReport=record RadiologyReport(reportId = e.reportId, examId = e.examId, studyId = prompt("the study id from studyInfo"), patientId = prompt("the patient id from the order"), radiologistId = e.radiologistId, reportStatus = ReportStatus.Draft, findings = e.findings, impression = e.impression, recommendations = e.recommendations, comparisonStudies = empty, criticalFinding = empty, dictatedAt = e.createdAt, signedAt = empty, transcribedBy = empty)
+lastAddendumAt:TimeStamp?=e.addedAt; +lastAddendumBy:PhysicianId?=e.radiologistId; addendums=prompt("the addendums with a report carrying addendumText and addendumReason appended")
assignedEmployeeId=e.replacementEmployeeId; assignedEmployeeName=prompt("the replacement employee's name, looked up by replacementEmployeeId")
currentStockLevel=e.remainingStockLevel; inventoryItemStatus=prompt("InStock, LowStock or OutOfStock by comparing remainingStockLevel with configuredReorderThreshold")
currentStockLevel=e.adjustedStockLevel; inventoryItemStatus=prompt("InStock, LowStock or OutOfStock by comparing adjustedStockLevel with configuredReorderThreshold")

+menuItemUpdatedAt:TimeStamp?=e.menuItemUpdatedAt; menuItemName=prompt("the updated name, if the update changed it"); menuItemDescription=prompt("the updated description, if the update changed it"); recipe=prompt("the updated recipe, if the update changed it")
releaseItems=prompt("the release items with releaseMenuItemId added or removed according to releaseAction")
reservedQuantity=prompt("reservedQuantity minus quantity"); status=prompt("Available when nothing remains reserved, else Reserved"); lastUpdated=e.timestamp
quantity=prompt("quantity minus the shipped quantity"); reservedQuantity=prompt("reservedQuantity minus the shipped quantity"); status=InventoryStatus.InTransit; lastUpdated=e.timestamp
channelAllocations=prompt("the channel allocations with allocation added, replacing any for the same channel")
targetAudiences=prompt("the target audiences with audience appended")
targetAudiences=prompt("the target audiences without the one whose id is audienceId")

channelMetrics=prompt("the channel metrics with channelPerformance replacing any for the same channel"); aggregateMetrics=prompt("the aggregate metrics re-summed over channelMetrics"); info.spentBudget=prompt("spentBudget plus channelPerformance.metrics.spend")
teamMembers=prompt("the team members with member appended"); +lastTeamMemberAssignedOn:Date?=e.member.assignedDate
teamMembers=prompt("the team members without the one whose id is memberId"); lastUpdated=e.removedAt
timeEntries=prompt("the time entries with timeEntry appended"); +lastTimeEntryOn:Date?=e.timeEntry.date
documents=prompt("the documents with document appended"); lastUpdated=e.document.uploadedAt
courtDates=prompt("the court dates with courtDate appended"); +nextCourtDate:DateTime?=e.courtDate.scheduledDate
courtDates=prompt("the court dates without the one whose id is dateId"); lastUpdated=e.cancelledAt
notes=prompt("the notes with note appended"); lastUpdated=e.note.createdAt
info.severity=e.newSeverity; info.affectedServices=prompt("the affected services with additionalServices appended")
